en.cc.label: Requirement check
en.cc.kind1Note: A building, road or network under construction or commissioned
en.cc.kind2Note: An administrative, commercial, residential or budget-funded building
en.cc.kind3Note: A production facility with high energy consumption
en.cc.hintApprox: If you don't have an exact figure, enter an estimate — the result is indicative.

en.cc.legalHint: This is a preliminary, indicative assessment. An official answer is given after the facility's documents are reviewed.
